name: k-manage
description: K-Manage — logiciel de gestion commerciale (MERN + TypeScript)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @k-manage/server" "npm run dev -w @k-manage/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @k-manage/server && npm run build -w @k-manage/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @k-manage/shared && npm run test -w @k-manage/server && npm run test -w @k-manage/client
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @k-manage/shared && npm run test:coverage -w @k-manage/server && npm run test:coverage -w @k-manage/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @k-manage/shared && npm run typecheck -w @k-manage/server && npm run typecheck -w @k-manage/client
